messages:
maria: Hey team — quick help needed. Partner needs a prosthetic leg, vendor is out-of-network and the initial claim was denied for lack of pre-auth. We have a surgery scheduled in two weeks and deadline to appeal vendor decision is next week. Is there a fast way to get an exception / pre-auth expedited?
sophie: Hi Maria — sorry to hear that. Short answer: yes, but we need a few docs ASAP. Can you share member ID (DM) and the vendor quote? Benefits team can fast-track an exception if there’s no adequate in-network option.
benefits-bot: Hi Maria — Please submit a pre-auth request at https://benefits.redwood.example.com/preauth and attach: 1) itemized prosthesis quote, 2) prosthetist treatment plan, 3) surgeon/physician letter of medical necessity. Typical turnaround 5-7 business days; mark as "expedite" for scheduled surgery.
ram: If they're out of state, we need to confirm network coverage by CPT/LT codes. Common prosthetic codes: L5856 (prosthetic, knee), L5987 (socket). Ask the vendor to include exact HCPCS/CPT. I can ping NetworkOps to check for any nearby in-network vendors within 100 miles.
maria: Thanks — sending DM with member ID now. Vendor quote attached to the DM. Vendor included HCPCS codes and a price estimate.
liz-caseworker: Adding process note — upload the vendor quote and physician letter to the pre-auth form and also email people-ops@redwood.com with subject "URGENT: prosthetic pre-auth — member 9XXXX" so we have a manual case. That triggers an internal case manager assignment.
chris: Quick Q: if exception is denied, will partner be eligible for partial reimbursement under out-of-network benefits? How do we get an estimate of expected OOP?
sophie: Good question. If exception denied, it falls under out-of-network benefits: reimbursement after deductible at usual and customary rates. We can request a pre-determination to estimate OOP — takes 3-5 business days after docs submitted. For expedited, request both pre-auth and pre-determination together.
ram: Also recommend attaching a geographic access statement from the vendor: "No in-network vendor within 50 miles" — that strengthens exception. If vendor can't provide, NetworkOps can run a network search and produce one.
maria: Vendor sent a short access statement — attaching in the DM. Also vendor prefers direct billing to insurer; do we have a way to route claims to insurer before service?
liz-caseworker: Yes — include "direct billing request" in the pre-auth form and set billing preference to insurer. We’ll ask payer to accept direct claim submission. If payer agrees, vendor will need payer EDI details — I can share a contact.
chris: Any standard email template for the vendor to expedite?
sophie: Use this quick template and paste in vendor quote + codes:

To: benefits@insurer.example.com
Subject: Urgent pre-authorization request — Member 9XXXX — scheduled procedure YYYY-MM-DD
Body:
Member: [name], DOB: [mm/dd/yyyy], Member ID: 9XXXX
Vendor: [vendor name], NPI: [#####], HCPCS/CPT: [L5856, ...]
Procedure date: [YYYY-MM-DD]
Attachments: itemized quote, physician letter, access statement
Request: expedited pre-auth and pre-determination; request direct billing acceptance

ram: I'll draft the email and cc NetworkOps. If we don't hear back in 48 hours, escalate to insurer's provider relations.
maria: Appreciate it. One last thing — will FSA/HSA cover any parts if we're paying OOP?
sophie: Yes, prosthetic devices are typically eligible for FSA/HSA. Keep receipts and EOB. If the claim is denied and you pay OOP, you can submit for reimbursement to HSA/FSA.
maria: Got it. Sending full package now. Thank you all! :heart: :raised_hands:
benefits-bot: Case created: pre-auth #PA-2026-998. Assigned to liz-caseworker. ETA for expedited review: 72 hours. If you need a PDF of the pre-auth form, reply here.
liz-caseworker: Got it — I'll follow up with insurer and vendor today and post updates here.
sophie: If anyone else hits this, ping me or DM the benefits-bot and we can reuse the same template.
ram: Sending vendor relations note now.
maria: Update — vendor confirmed they can direct bill and uploaded final quote. Thanks everyone.
liz-caseworker: Update 1831123399 — insurer acknowledged receipt and marked as expedited. Will update when decision comes back.
